description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayConnectionController, verifying its behavior in different scenarios such as display name resolution, capability toggles, command inclusion, operator connection options, and last connection persistence.

classes.name: GatewayConnectionControllerTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for GatewayConnectionController functionality and behaviors.

methods.name: resolvedDisplayNameSetsDefaultWhenMissing
methods.description: Tests that the display name defaults properly when missing from user defaults.

methods.name: currentCapsReflectToggles
methods.description: Verifies that current capabilities reflect toggles set in user defaults.

methods.name: currentCommandsIncludeLocationWhenEnabled
methods.description: Ensures location commands are included when location is enabled.

methods.name: currentCommandsExcludeDangerousSystemExecCommands
methods.description: Checks that dangerous system commands are excluded from the current commands.

methods.name: operatorConnectOptionsOnlyRequestApprovalScopeWhenEnabled
methods.description: Tests that operator connect options include approval scope only when enabled.

methods.name: operatorApprovalScopeRequestsStayBackwardCompatible
methods.description: Verifies backward compatibility of operator approval scope requests.

methods.name: loadLastConnectionReadsSavedValues
methods.description: Ensures loading last connection retrieves correctly saved data.

methods.name: loadLastConnectionReturnsNilForInvalidData
methods.description: Test that invalid last connection data returns nil when loading.
